title: MIRL Glean: images gathered from open collections
description: A no-build, local-first tool that sends one search to twenty-two open museum, library, and archive collections at once and returns one set of results with every licence read into a plain rights state. Picked images keep their records, Chicago citations, and a picks file the user holds; downloads come as a zip whose manifest records each file's sha-256, source, retrieval time, and rights. Thirty further collections with no open search API, among them JSTOR through a library proxy and archives of the Arab world, open with the same query. Arabic and right-to-left ready.
